mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, warehouse_id, virtual_warehouse_id, sku_id, sku_no, bill_date, qty, dict_inventory_status, virtual_trans_flow_id, batch_no, last_outstock_date
mapper.select: select * from ( WITH virtualInventoryDetailHis AS ( select max(vidh.date) as date, max(vidh.update_time) as updateTime, vid.sku_id, vid.warehouse_id, vid.virtual_warehouse_id, sum(vidh.wait_qty * vidh.inventory_age_days) as backInventoryAgeQty, sum(vidh.qty * vidh.inventory_age_days) as inventoryAgeQty from virtual_inventory_detail_his vidh left join virtual_inventory_detail vid on vidh.virtual_inventory_detail_id = vid.id and vid.is_deleted = false where vidh.is_deleted = false and vidh.date = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' group by vid.sku_id,vid.warehouse_id,vid.virtual_warehouse_id ),VirtualInventoryHis AS ( SELECT max(vih.date) as date, vi.sku_id, vi.warehouse_id, vi.virtual_warehouse_id, SUM(vih.qty) AS virtualQty, SUM(CASE WHEN vi.dict_inventory_status = 'usable' THEN vih.qty ELSE 0 END) AS virtualUsableQty, SUM(CASE WHEN vi.dict_inventory_status = 'frozen' THEN vih.qty ELSE 0 END) AS virtualFrozenQty FROM virtual_inventory_his vih left join virtual_inventory vi on vih.virtual_inventory_id = vi.id and vi.is_deleted = false WHERE vih.is_deleted = false and vih.date = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY vi.sku_id, vi.warehouse_id, vi.virtual_warehouse_id ) select vidh.sku_id as skuId, pd.sku_no as skuNo, vidh.warehouse_id as warehouseId, wh."name" as warehouseName, vidh.virtual_warehouse_id as virtualWarehouseId, vw.code as virtualWarehouseCode, vw.name as virtualWarehouseName, case when vih.virtualQty = 0 then 0 else round(vidh.inventoryAgeQty * 1.0 / vih.virtualQty,4) end as avgInventoryAge, case when vih.virtualQty = 0 then 0 else round(vidh.backInventoryAgeQty / vih.virtualQty,4) end as backAvgInventoryAge from virtualInventoryDetailHis vidh left join VirtualInventoryHis vih on vidh.sku_id = vih.sku_id and vidh.warehouse_id = vih.warehouse_id and vidh.virtual_warehouse_id = vih.virtual_warehouse_id left join product_detail pd on vidh.sku_id = pd.id and pd.is_deleted = false left join warehouse wh on vidh.warehouse_id = wh.id and wh.is_deleted = false left join virtual_warehouse vw on vidh.virtual_warehouse_id = vw.id and vw.is_deleted = false ) as all_data where avgInventoryAge != backAvgInventoryAge

select * from ( WITH virtualInventoryDetailHis AS ( select vid.sku_id, vid.virtual_warehouse_id, sum(vidh.wait_qty * vidh.inventory_age_days) as backInventoryAgeQty, sum(vidh.qty * vidh.inventory_age_days) as inventoryAgeQty from virtual_inventory_detail_his vidh left join virtual_inventory_detail vid on vidh.virtual_inventory_detail_id = vid.id and vid.is_deleted = false where vidh.is_deleted = false and vidh.date = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' group by vid.sku_id,vid.virtual_warehouse_id ),VirtualInventoryHis AS ( SELECT vi.sku_id, vi.virtual_warehouse_id, SUM(vih.qty) AS virtualQty, SUM(CASE WHEN vi.dict_inventory_status = 'usable' THEN vih.qty ELSE 0 END) AS virtualUsableQty, SUM(CASE WHEN vi.dict_inventory_status = 'frozen' THEN vih.qty ELSE 0 END) AS virtualFrozenQty FROM virtual_inventory_his vih left join virtual_inventory vi on vih.virtual_inventory_id = vi.id and vi.is_deleted = false WHERE vih.is_deleted = false and vih.date = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY vi.sku_id, vi.virtual_warehouse_id ) select vidh.sku_id as skuId, pd.sku_no as skuNo, vidh.virtual_warehouse_id as virtualWarehouseId, vw.code as virtualWarehouseCode, vw.name as virtualWarehouseName, case when vih.virtualQty = 0 then 0 else round(vidh.inventoryAgeQty * 1.0 / vih.virtualQty,4) end as avgInventoryAge, case when vih.virtualQty = 0 then 0 else round(vidh.backInventoryAgeQty / vih.virtualQty,4) end as backAvgInventoryAge from virtualInventoryDetailHis vidh left join VirtualInventoryHis vih on vidh.sku_id = vih.sku_id and vidh.virtual_warehouse_id = vih.virtual_warehouse_id left join product_detail pd on vidh.sku_id = pd.id and pd.is_deleted = false left join virtual_warehouse vw on vidh.virtual_warehouse_id = vw.id and vw.is_deleted = false ) as all_data where avgInventoryAge != backAvgInventoryAge
